peak_definition: v2 = max 1-min close since previous call (peak_1m)
stopped: no Q-bar stop; 9 days run to completion
record_stamp: brief_sha + peak_def in every day record; v2 without peak_def==1m is re-run
page_hash_def: sha256[:16] of BRIEF_V2 + context(2026-02-05 12:50Z, self_aware, band=False, leg_list=False); scripts/s_line_diagnostics.py --page-hash

in_sample_days.2026-02-05: read trade-by-trade in Step 1; A1.1 page fix and A1.2 Q5 amendments were written after reading

expected_spend: 9 day-runs x ~138 calls = ~1,240 calls; ~120M billable tokens; ~4-5h wall-clock at 2 workers; every stop trigger suspended by A2 item 4, so this is uninterruptible by rule (the operator can still stop it).
baseline_result_file: reports/recursive_loop/S1_BASELINE.json (written by scripts/s_line_diagnostics.py --tag sline_s1b --write; S2 reads this, not a write-up)
poisoned_day_rerun_cap: forward_days.py makes at most 3 passes (first run + 2 re-runs); a day still >10% errored after that is reported excluded, never counted
